title_as_printed: Private Journal kept on board H.M.S. Favorite on the Newfoundland Station. By Captain H. Robinson, R.N. 1820.
author: H. Robinson (journal); vocabulary by Rev. J. Leigh
journal: Journal of the Royal Geographical Society of London
heading_as_printed: Vocabulary of the Language of the Natives of Newfoundland; procured by the Rev. J. Leigh, from Mary March, a Native Woman, taken up the Bay of Exploits by Mr. Peyton, in March, 1818.
about: The Rev. J. Leigh, Church Missionary, took down these words from Mary March, a Native woman of Newfoundland captured up the Bay of Exploits by Mr. Peyton in March 1818, who lived in his house.
